decision_targets: continuous after-cost R values, not probability labels

ridge.numeric_preprocessing: per-column training median imputation, all-null train column -> 0; append one missing flag per numeric; StandardScaler(ddof=0) on imputed numeric columns only; zero variance scale=1
ridge.categorical_preprocessing: fixed domain one-hot from FEATURE_DEFINITIONS.json; missing and unseen are distinct reserved categories; no target encoding; no intercept penalty

catboost.fit_policy: No outer eval_set, early stopping, calibration or pruning; numeric NaN stays native; same numeric missing flags; fixed categorical missing/unseen tokens; train-only quantization.

constant_predictor.value: arithmetic mean of same fit's eligible resolved training labels

validity.all_invalid_fold_action: unmodified baseline and explicit unavailable model, never fabricate zero-score predictions

predictions.action_rule: finite prediction strictly < 0 changes action; zero/nonfinite/unavailable falls back

environment: Resolve working installed package/Python/BLAS versions and hash them before fitting; no forced upgrade. Necessary dependencies may be installed in the task-only environment, without touching production.
defaults_status: Explicit study-design choices for this first phase; not claimed statistically optimal or proven by prior runs.
